safety_layer.note: keyword safety layer, independent of every model; checked against the project's own 'urgent' topic flag

limitations: Labels come from the project's own topic list; no clinician-reviewed reference answers exist, so factual correctness is NOT measured automatically (use the User Study / human rubric).
Test set is small (see n_test) and author-written, so differences of a few points are within noise.
Latency was measured on this machine, single-threaded, models already loaded.
No model is declared the overall winner: accuracy, latency and safety are reported separately.
